description: TheShop.mu delivers groceries across Mauritius. After connecting their TheShop account once, users can search the catalogue, compare prices with VAT included, keep their cart up to date, check past orders and payment status, see which delivery details would be reused, and place orders within the spending limits they set on theshop.mu. Every order is paid by the customer on a secure payment page; the assistant never handles card details. Access can be revoked at any time from the customer's account page.

defaultPrompt: Find me the cheapest 1 litre olive oil at TheShop
